verdict.rationale: Codex documents its own sandboxing: cloud tasks run in isolated environments, and the CLI's /permissions command lets you choose when Codex can edit files or run commands without asking, and inspect the active sandbox and writable roots. Sandboxing of network access and of tool and MCP calls is not documented. Community comments only raise questions or worries, so they do not create a dispute. Missing for 10: documented network-egress sandboxing or controls, explicit sandbox scope for tool and MCP calls, details of the sandbox mechanism and platform support, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can have the agent operate inside a sandbox when interacting with code, tools, and network resources

citations.quote: Run tasks in isolated cloud environments
